golden.question: What leverage is outside the bank's appetite?
golden.answer: The bank's appetite for senior leverage is up to 4.0x Debt to EBITDA for sub-investment-grade corporates. [CP-001 §3.2] Transactions above 6.0x are outside appetite and require a documented exception approved by the Chief Risk Officer. [CP-001 §3.2]

golden.question: Who approves an exposure above personal delegated authority?
golden.answer: Exposures above personal delegated authority, and all exposures to clients rated 7 or worse on the internal rating scale, must be approved by the EMEA Credit Committee, which meets weekly. [CP-001 §2.2] Credit officers hold personal delegated authority up to GBP 25 million per obligor group for investment-grade clients and up to GBP 10 million for sub-investment-grade clients. [CP-001 §2.1]

golden.question: When must an exposure be referred to the Group Credit Committee in Tokyo?
golden.answer: Any single obligor group exposure above GBP 250 million must also be referred to the Group Credit Committee in Tokyo before approval. [CP-001 §2.3]

golden.question: What is the minimum interest cover at origination for sub-investment-grade borrowers?
golden.answer: Interest cover, EBITDA divided by net interest expense, must not fall below 3.0x at origination for sub-investment-grade borrowers. [CP-001 §3.3] Term loans to sub-investment-grade borrowers must include a leverage covenant and an interest cover covenant, tested quarterly on a rolling twelve-month basis. [CP-001 §3.1]

golden.question: What happens to a credit limit that is not reviewed on time?
golden.answer: Every corporate credit limit must be reviewed at least annually. [CP-001 §4.1] A limit that is not reviewed within 30 days of its review date is suspended for new drawings. [CP-001 §4.1]

golden.question: When must a client be added to the watchlist?
golden.answer: A client must be added to the watchlist within 5 business days if a covenant is breached, a payment is more than 30 days past due, or the internal rating is downgraded by two notches or more. [CP-001 §4.2]

golden.question: How quickly must a covenant breach be reported to Credit Risk?
golden.answer: A covenant breach must be reported by the relationship manager to Credit Risk within 2 business days of becoming aware of it. [CP-001 §5.1]

golden.question: What is the final hold limit for a leveraged transaction?
golden.answer: The final hold for any single leveraged transaction must not exceed GBP 75 million, and underwriting commitments above GBP 150 million need a syndication plan approved by the Leveraged Finance Committee. [CP-002 §2.3] A leveraged transaction is any loan to a sub-investment-grade borrower where total Debt to EBITDA exceeds 4.0x at origination, or any loan to a borrower owned by a financial sponsor. [CP-002 §1.1]

golden.question: How much of EBITDA can be added back for projected synergies?
golden.answer: Add-backs to EBITDA for projected synergies or cost savings are capped at 20 percent of reported EBITDA and must be supported by third-party diligence. [CP-002 §2.2]

golden.question: What is the rates desk Value at Risk limit?
golden.answer: The EMEA Rates desk has a one-day 99 percent Value at Risk limit of GBP 4.5 million. [CM-001 §1.1] A hard limit breach must be escalated to the Head of Market Risk within one hour and the position reduced within the limit by the end of the next business day unless a temporary increase is approved. [CM-001 §2.1]

golden.question: How long can a temporary limit increase last?
golden.answer: A hard limit breach must be escalated to the Head of Market Risk within one hour and the position reduced within the limit by the end of the next business day unless a temporary increase is approved. [CM-001 §2.1] Temporary limit increases may be granted by the Head of Market Risk for up to 10 business days and must be reported to the Asset and Liability Committee. [CM-001 §2.2]

golden.question: What is the PV01 limit in any single currency curve?
golden.answer: Aggregate interest rate sensitivity is limited to GBP 350,000 per basis point across all currencies, and GBP 150,000 per basis point in any single currency curve. [CM-001 §1.3]

golden.question: Can traders trade on research before it is published?
golden.answer: Traders must not trade on the contents of research before it has been published. [CM-002 §2.1]

golden.question: What approval is needed to wall-cross a public-side employee?
golden.answer: Wall-crossing a public-side employee requires prior approval from Compliance, which records the crossing on the insider list. [CM-002 §1.2]

golden.question: By what time must variation margin calls be issued?
golden.answer: Variation margin calls are calculated daily for every counterparty with a Credit Support Annex and must be issued by 11:00 London time. [CM-003 §1.1]

golden.question: When must a margin dispute be escalated?
golden.answer: A margin dispute above GBP 1 million, or any dispute lasting more than 3 business days, must be escalated to the Head of Collateral Operations and reported to Credit Risk. [CM-003 §2.1]

golden.question: Can restricted information be used in any approved AI tool?
golden.answer: They must not paste MNPI or client-confidential information into any AI tool that is not approved for restricted data. [CM-002 §2.2] Public and internal information may be used with any approved tool. [GR-001 §1.2]

golden.question: Within what time must suspected AI incidents be reported?
golden.answer: Suspected AI incidents, including data leakage, harmful output or prompt injection, must be reported to the AI Engineering on-call team through the service desk within 24 hours. [GR-001 §3.1]

golden.question: Is a change of prompt template in a Tier 1 generative AI system a model change?
golden.answer: A change of foundation model version, embedding model, prompt template or retrieval configuration in a Tier 1 or Tier 2 generative AI system is a model change. [GR-002 §3.1] Generative AI systems that support credit decisions, client communications or regulatory reporting are Tier 1 or Tier 2. [GR-002 §2.1]

golden.question: How often must Tier 1 models be revalidated?
golden.answer: Tier 1 models are independently validated before use and revalidated at least annually. [GR-002 §2.2] Tier 2 models are revalidated at least every two years. [GR-002 §2.2]

golden.question: What is the margin on the Project Heron term loan B?
golden.answer: The term loan B margin is SONIA plus 4.25 percent with a 1 percent original issue discount. [DEAL-HERON §2.1] The bank will underwrite a GBP 420 million senior term loan B and a GBP 60 million revolving credit facility, with a final hold target of GBP 70 million after syndication. [DEAL-HERON §1.2]
